name: La marca blanca del dedo

shots.sound: Murmullo de comensales y cubiertos contra los platos.
shots.action: Lucía, en primer término, deja caer el paño de lino sobre la cesta, sonríe con los dientes apretados y se sienta, manos planas sobre el mantel, marca blanca del dedo arriba.
shots.caption: Bajo el lino quedan tres anillos viejos.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot at eye level of a woman in the left foreground, seated at a dining table, lips stretched in a tight clenched-teeth smile aimed past the camera, both hands flat on the white tablecloth, a pale band of skin on her ring finger. A white linen cloth falls over a wicker basket at the lower right. Warm lamplight, blurred relatives at the table in the background.
shots.video_prompt: The linen cloth settles over the wicker basket as the woman sits, flattens her hands on the tablecloth and says her line through a tight smile; slow push-in; low dinner murmur and cutlery clinks.

shots.sound: Murmullo de sobremesa, cristal contra el mantel.
shots.action: Lucía, en primer término a la izquierda, vacía la copa de un trago con los ojos clavados en la cesta que un tío pasa de mano en mano. Al fondo, Rosario se limpia los labios con la servilleta.
shots.caption: La cesta da la vuelta a la mesa sin prisa.

dialogue.line: Lucía, hija, ayúdame con los platos del postre.
dialogue.speaker: ROSARIO

shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of LUCÍA in the left foreground, head tilted back, an empty wine glass at her lips, eyes cut sideways toward a wicker basket under a linen cloth, blurred in the right midground in a man's hands. ROSARIO small and sharp in the background, dabbing her lips with a napkin. Warm dim lamplight over a dinner table at night.
shots.video_prompt: LUCÍA lowers the empty glass, her eyes following the basket as a man's hands pass it along; in the background ROSARIO dabs her lips and speaks. Slow push-in on LUCÍA; murmur of dinner chatter, glass touching the tablecloth.

shots.sound: Chirrido de la silla contra el suelo, luego silencio.
shots.action: Lucía, de pie junto a la silla echada hacia atrás, aprieta la servilleta en el puño y abre la boca sin decir nada. Detrás, los comensales mantienen los tenedores en el aire.
shots.caption: Todos esperan. Ella no encuentra qué decir.
shots.image_prompt: Low-angle full shot of LUCÍA standing at frame right beside a wooden chair pushed back at a slant, her fist clenched around a crumpled napkin at hip height, mouth slightly open, eyes wide. Behind her at the table, diners frozen with forks raised, warm amber lamplight, dark corridor opening at the far left.
shots.video_prompt: The chair scrapes to a stop; LUCÍA tightens her fist on the napkin, opens her mouth and holds it, no sound comes out. Behind her the diners stay frozen with forks raised. Static camera; chair screech, then silence.

shots.sound: Zumbido de la bombilla; al otro lado de la puerta, el crujido del mimbre de la cesta.
shots.action: Con la espalda contra la puerta cerrada, Lucía se mira en el espejo moteado bajo la bombilla desnuda y frota con el pulgar la marca blanca del anular.
shots.caption: Al otro lado, alguien rebusca en la cesta.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of LUCÍA in the lower right of the vertical frame, her back flat against a closed wooden door, head turned toward a speckled mirror on the left that reflects her tense face. Her right thumb rubs the pale band on her ring finger, held at chest height. A bare bulb overhead casts harsh yellow light and deep shadows under her eyes. Cold tiled wall blurred behind.
shots.video_prompt: Lucía's thumb rubs the white mark on her ring finger while her eyes stay fixed on her reflection; slow push-in toward her face; bulb hum, then wicker creaking faintly behind the door.

chapter.logline: Lucía quiere decir en voz alta lo que ha visto en la cesta del pan, pero al oír su nombre solo consigue llegar hasta el aseo.
chapter.exit_question: ¿Volverá Lucía al comedor, y con qué intención, mientras su anillo sigue en la cesta?
chapter.entry_question: ¿Cómo sonríe alguien que acaba de ver tres anillos viejos bajo un paño?

new_places.name: ASEO DE LA CASA
new_places.visual_description: Tiny village-house bathroom with faded green tiles, a chipped porcelain sink, an oval mirror with a spotted silver edge and a bare bulb overhead giving yellow light
